SSP Post-Matric Scholarship

The Government of Karnataka invites applications for the Post-Matric Scholarship from eligible SC/ST students studying in post-secondary institutions.

Navigation Menu
description: Financial assistance provided for SC/ST students pursuing higher education across Karnataka colleges.
benefits: Book bank facilities for professional courses
eligibility: Applicants must be between 18 and 30 years of age
Must belong to SC or ST category in Karnataka
Annual family income should not exceed Rs. 2.5 lakh
Must have passed previous qualifying examination with minimum 50% marks
documents_required: Income Certificate (showing family income below Rs 2.5 lakhs)
Bank Account Passbook linked with Aadhaar
application_process:
1. Visit official SSP Portal at https://ssp.karnataka.gov.in/
2. Register using Aadhaar number and e-KYC
3. Upload required documents and submit online application.

title: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
department: Department of Women and Child Development
description:
Official Notice
Financial security scheme offering monthly financial support of ₹2,000 to the woman head of eligible families in Karnataka. All Rights Reserved © 2026 Government of Karnataka.
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of ₹2,000 per month into bank account
Empowerment of female heads of households
eligibility: Woman head of the family named in BPL or APL ration cards
Age of applicant must be minimum 18 years and below 60 years
Neither applicant nor spouse should be an income tax payer
Annual family income should not exceed ₹2 lakh
documents_required: Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
application_process: Apply online at Seva Sindhu Portal (https://sevasindhugs1.karnataka.gov.in/gl-sp/) or visit nearest Grama One/Karnataka One centers.

department: Department of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Unemployment assistance scheme for degree and diploma graduates in Karnataka.
benefits: ₹1,500 monthly allowance for unemployed diploma holders
Skill training assistance for job seekers
eligibility: Applicants must be between 18 and 30 years of age
Must have passed Degree/Diploma in academic year 2023-24 onwards
Must be unemployed for at least 180 days after graduation
application_process: Register online on Seva Sindhu Portal with Aadhaar authentication.
